Nightmare.Phobia1Description:
While Lake Laroba is in sight, take a –2 status penalty to Athletics checks. Use the deep water toggle on this effect.

This is a curse and lasts 24 hours.
Nightmare.Phobia2Description:
Whenever you take fire damage, become frightened 1. The native effect reminds you; the GM confirms and applies the condition.

This is a curse and lasts 24 hours.
Nightmare.Phobia3Description:
When flanked, become frightened 1. The native effect reminds you; the GM confirms and applies the condition.

This is a curse and lasts 24 hours.
Nightmare.Phobia4Description:
Outside bright light, take a –1 circumstance penalty to Will saves, or –2 in darkness. Set the effect toggle for current light.

This is a curse and lasts 24 hours.
Nightmare.Phobia5Description:
When you see a creature within 30 feet take persistent bleed damage or a critical hit from a weapon Strike, become sickened 1; sickened 2 if you are the target. The GM confirms the trigger.

This is a curse and lasts 24 hours.
Nightmare.Phobia6Description:
You cannot benefit from Aid or flank with an ally. To accept a beneficial effect from an ally, succeed at a DC 26 Will save. The GM adjudicates a failure.

This is a curse and lasts 24 hours.
Nightmare.Phobia7Description:
You are off-guard outdoors or in an area without a roof. Set the effect toggle for the current environment.

This is a curse and lasts 24 hours.
Nightmare.Phobia8Description:
You are off-guard against arachnids. A critical hit from one or a web effect also makes you slowed 1. Set the effect toggle for this encounter; the GM confirms the additional condition.

This is a curse and lasts 24 hours.
Nightmare.Phobia9Description:
When combat starts against a monstrous enemy, attempt @Check[will|dc:31|name:Will save|options:inflicts:slowed,inflicts:stunned]. On failure, you are slowed 1 for this combat; on critical failure, you are stunned 3 first, then slowed 1 for this combat.

This is a curse and lasts 24 hours.
